text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to The Dojo Invitational! In this corner, a relentless pressure fighter wearing a face built from their very own photos! New training top and shorts lifted the realism score from 33 to 35! But the judge warns those jagged shell edges, open gaps at the waist and hips, and X Bot ball joints still read like a mannequin under a real face. Standing one point eight two meters, packing over ninety-one thousand triangles, give it up for the Mannequin with a Mugshot, THE OWNER!
